All other points reach the explicitly invariant compact graph; direct section algebra gives exactly three onto branches with slopes 4,4,-2 and original-time return lengths 6,5,5. Normalized Lebesgue is the exact section probability, with independent branch weights 1/4,1/4,1/2 and mean roof 21/4. The finite invariant tower establishes the unique full-planar-basin physical law and Abramov entropy (2/7) log 2. The finite-to-one graph coding is a renewal Markov system, so Perron equation lambda^-6+2lambda^-5=1 gives top entropy; the KL equality condition makes the gap strict. The actual standalone standard-library checker passed 1,198 rational branch/graph tests. The proof, not finite tests, supports the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The open-access originating study explicitly anticipates rigorous ergodic consequences of its one-dimensional reduction. The point tau_L=1,tau_R=0,delta_R=2 is a natural positive-determinant quarter-turn focus with integral return geometry; it supports a globally capturing finite graph rather than a selected invariant Cantor set. The exactly computed full-planar-basin physical entropy differs strictly from the exact topological entropy in original time, giving a nontrivial diagnostic of unequal excursion lengths. It supplies a complete soluble benchmark for the measure-theoretic versus topological complexity of a truly two-dimensional, partly collapsing piecewise-affine recurrence. No robustness or broader-parameter theorem is claimed.
